context: Representative implementation cleanup from the issue: add behavior while replacing AI-written isPresent/get upsert flow with a lazy Optional boundary.

checklist.name: Creates revised class
checklist.description: Creates WorkpadService.java with the requested class, imports, methods, and records.

checklist.name: Uses Optional as update/create boundary
checklist.description: Refactors the existing lookup into a direct update-or-create Optional boundary such as findFirst().map(...).orElseGet(...), with helper methods if useful.

checklist.name: Keeps create lazy
checklist.description: Does not execute comment-window checks or create logic when an existing workpad comment is present.

checklist.name: Removes presence-check value read
checklist.description: Does not keep isPresent()/isEmpty() followed by get() or orElseThrow() for ordinary workpad value reads.

checklist.name: Avoids null/list workaround
checklist.description: Does not replace the Optional with orElse(null), local null branching, Optional.stream().toList(), or a loop over one Optional.

checklist.name: Adds missing-id safeguard
checklist.description: Returns Result.failure("missing_action_id") for existing workpad comments whose id is null or blank.

checklist.name: Adds window safeguard
checklist.description: Returns Result.failure("comment_window_incomplete") when no workpad exists and the comment window has at least 1000 comments.

checklist.name: Preserves success statuses
checklist.description: Preserves updated:id:text and created:cardId:text status formats.
